regions.merged_text: Many thanks again for your cooperation in the privileged work of the poor missions. Thanks be to God, though my shins are stiff and a little swollen, they are improving and I hope in a short time to get at my regular schedule. I hope nothing serious be found with Esther and that she be back soon in good shape. I just received a letter from Fr. Maurice in Gracevill Minn. You remember he was six years in Mt. Hope San. Baltimore. Thank God he seems to coming along o. He was installed out there as Chaplin last Mar. Msgr. Edw'd still working in St. Paul - till his Most Rev. Bishop call him back to the Islands - lecturing, giving missions, retreats, etc. . God bless you one and all again.
